title: [BUG] Broadcasting Client 2 to Client 1 and Display on Smartwatch won't work, all V4 latest dev
body: Description I'm trying to display data from Client 2 on the Wear OS watch connected to Client 1, but only Client 1 data is shown on the watchface. Setup - AndroidAPS V4 - Two children running separate AAPS clients: - Client 1 - Client 2 - AAPS Wear APK installed only for Client 1 - Client 2: - Broadcasting enabled - Client 1: - Broadcasting disabled - Dual watchface enabled - Include external data in watchface enabled Expected behavior The watchface on the watch paired with Client 1 should display the broadcasted data from Client 2 as external data in the dual watchface. Actual behavior Only Client 1 data is displayed on the watchface. No values from Client 2 appear on the watchface. Steps to reproduce 1. Install AndroidAPS V4 on Client 1 and Client 2. 2. Install the Wear APK only for Client 1. 3. Enable Broadcasting on Client 2. 4. Disable Broadcasting on Client 1. 5. Enable Dual watchface on Client 1. 6. Enable Include external data in watchface on Client 1. 7. Open the watchface on the smartwatch connected to Client 1. Question Am I missing an additional configuration step required for Client 1 to receive and display broadcasted data from Client 2 on the Wear OS watchface?
